basic_details.job_title: SPA Vijayawada Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Research Assistant post under the Preparation of Tiruchirappalli Regional Plan (TRP) Project at the School of Planning and Architecture, Vijayawada (SPA Vijayawada) is a purely contract engagement for a period of 3 months at Rs. 45,000/- (Consolidated) a month. The project is funded by the Directorate of Town and Country Planning, Government of TamilNadu. One post is advertised; the qualifications listed are B.Plan (with GIS Software knowledge) and M.Plan (with expertise in GIS Software and Analysis). Candidates apply through a Google form till 28 November 2026, and shortlisted candidates

how_to_apply: Open the Google form given in the notice at https://forms.gle/n6VmKc4kRFGhLfPy7.
Fill in the G-form till 28 November 2026.
If shortlisted, appear for the Online/Offline interview at the SPA Vijayawada campus on 30 November 2026.
The notice does not name any documents to be attached.
important_instructions: The engagement is temporary and purely on contract basis for a period of 3 months. The remuneration is Rs. 45,000/- (Consolidated) per month, as printed in the notice. A candidate who otherwise fulfils the minimum eligibility criterion can be rejected by CA without assigning any reason whatsoever, as the nature of work is purely contractual. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview, which may be Online or Offline.
